note: Veteran-family-owned private RV park at 20 Whitley Rd, Enigma, on US-82 east of Tifton; wide grassy sites, many shaded; dog park, pavilion, propane fills; welcomes Harvest Hosts guests and hurricane evacuees. Takes monthly stays as well as nightly ones. --Claude
summary: Operator rate page confirms $40 (30 A) / $45 (50 A) a day, full hookups and pull-through on every RV site (stored 40-45 confirmed; note's '$25-40/night' was out of date - $25 is the tent site). Books online on Park With Us (booking added). Engine: 47 numbered RV sites (1 host), 15-80 ft, 45 fit 23 ft; count 30 -> 46, max 80. Hookups/facilities now operator-sourced; year-round. Long-stay: posts nightly, weekly and monthly rates and 19 of 46 sites book online nightly - passes the five tests. Under the $50 gate. Phone 229-800-7275 matches the site. Pin ~1.7 km off - see flags.
flags: Pin ~1.7 km off: stored 31.40175,-83.38468 is on an empty stretch of Whitley Rd south of the park.
